pages.title: Synthesis Bench
pages.text: Flasks, condensers and a notebook: a molecule built step by step, working back from the target.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set how many steps the route takes. Each step keeps 92% of the material: fewer steps, more product - but a target cannot be made in fewer steps than it needs (the page gives them). The yield must reach the recipe's figure.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Chiral Ligand, EDTA, Fine Reagent.
